description:
As a user
  I want to add products to my shopping cart
  So that I can verify cart quantities

elements.name: Add multiple products to cart and verify cart page items

steps.name: I am on the SauceDemo login page
I login as "standardUser"
I should be redirected to the inventory page
I add the following products to cart:
the cart badge should show 2 items
I open the shopping cart
I should see product "Sauce Labs Backpack" with correct quantity and description in cart
I should see product "Sauce Labs Bike Light" with correct quantity and description in cart
the Remove button should be visible and enabled for all products in cart
the Checkout button should be visible and enabled with correct text
the Continue Shopping button should be visible and enabled with correct text
the cart badge should match the number of products added before removing
I remove product "Sauce Labs Backpack" from cart
the cart badge should decrease by 1 after removing product
